summary: Pluggable model role routing with dynamic fallback: role table + bounded failover in pool/resolver, env/config wiring, admin reload integration; SA task-routing stays separate.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing LLM client pool, runtime resolver, provider registry reload path. No new service, no execution authority change, no durable store.
components.disposition: Declarative model role table (primary/candidates per role) resolved at engine build; bounded dynamic failover in pool when primary is unavailable; resolver exposes resolved roles as mechanical facts; admin reload re-reads role config through existing providers_registry_reload path; env example documents the keys. No hardcoded model names; no knowledge-base coupling; no gate changes.
evidence: Work consolidated from two prior working trees: model-routing-20261125 (commit 651ee21e0, 9 staged files, base 6349346d8) and model-routing-final (12 items uncommitted, base 1f0601e9d). All 9 common files byte-identical across trees (diff -q verified); final tree is strict superset with extra config/factory/env wiring.
Directed tests green on final tree: test_model_roles / test_fallback_integration / test_m50_three_end / test_runtime_resolver (results recorded at delivery time).
Independent review and full R9 bound to the final frozen SHA, pending after this submission.
components.verification_level: Local directed tests + tree-consolidation verification; independent review, full R9, remote CI and production acceptance pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Role resolution and failover are mechanical provider facts; no tool/authority semantics change. Failover errors surface as provider errors, never as task success.
components.rollback_route: Protected revert of the role table wiring; pool/resolver fall back to existing single-model behaviour when role config absent. No schema or durable-state migration.
